name: acne-point-relabel-protocol-1
status: fixed before the first review sheet was viewed
nature: AI (assistant) engineering review of the same 28 DEV photos, done after earlier model results were known: NOT blind, NOT independent, NOT expert-verified, NOT an acceptance test

coordinateCheck.result: all 201 source boxes lie inside their image bounds in the same source-pixel system as the stored predictions (pack image = product input file; no resize)
coordinateCheck.normalized: box side / face width (MediaPipe 234-454): SmartSkinCare-type 1280px photos ~0.015-0.035; Skin-Problem-Detection large photos 0.04-0.08; i.e. the size gap is not only a pixel-scale effect

labelRule.target: TARGET = centre of one visible acne-like single lesion: papule / pustule / whitehead-like raised, red or white bump
otherCategories: SCAR_PIGMENT (flat brown/purple/red mark or pitted scar, texture area)
labelRule.uncertain: UNCERTAIN when the photo does not allow a reliable decision
labelRule.separate: close but separately visible lesions get separate points
labelRule.area: a scar/texture area is never one TARGET

review.view: label-free sheets: only original pixels + source-pixel grid; source boxes and model points hidden
review.tiles: face-oval bounding box (landmarks), tiles 0.5 x face width, 15% overlap, rendered 640 px, grid ~0.05 x face width
review.coverage: reviewed mask = face-oval polygon minus eyes, brows (dilated 0.03 fw) and lips, intersected with tiles marked reviewable, minus recorded exclusion rectangles (hair, beard, blur, occlusion, glare, collage seams, non-skin)
flags: low resolution (upscaling does not verify detail)
review.overlapMerge: same-category points within 0.015 x face width from overlapping tiles are merged (mean position)
review.freeze: layer-1 labels are saved and hashed before source boxes or model points are opened; layer-2 (model-assisted, after comparison) is kept separate and never replaces layer 1

scoring.coordinates: source px of the pack image

tolerance.primary: r = 0.03 x face width (~4 mm on a ~14 cm face; covers point-placement uncertainty ~0.0125 fw and typical lesion radius)
tolerance.rule: fixed now; never widened after results

scoring.matching: one-to-one TARGET points vs prediction points (box centres from stored final boxes); feasible if distance <= r; maximum cardinality then minimum total distance (linear_sum_assignment)
scoring.unmatchedPredictions: within r of an already matched TARGET -> duplicate; within r of OTHER -> that category; within r of UNCERTAIN -> uncertain; else inside reviewed mask -> false point on reviewed skin; inside face oval but outside reviewed mask -> unreviewed; outside face oval -> non-skin
scoring.models: all 37 stored model/mode records rescored; Jasnk copy not counted; no new inference
scoring.clear: the 14 Clear photos keep their earlier reviewed-mask results, reported separately
scoring.keep: earlier IoU and point-in-box results stay as separate diagnostic records
